---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

career_home_runs <- Batting |>
	group_by(playerID) |>
	summarise(
		career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
		first_season = min(yearID),
		last_season = max(yearID),
		.groups = "drop"
	) |>
	inner_join(
		People |>
			select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
		by = "playerID"
	) |>
	mutate(
		player = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " "),
		seasons_played = str_c(first_season, last_season, sep = "-"),
		steroid_era_status = factor(
			if_else(
				last_season >= 1994 & first_season <= 2009,
				"Active during steroid era",
				"Not active during steroid era"
			),
			levels = c(
				"Active during steroid era",
				"Not active during steroid era"
			)
		),
		player = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs)
	) |>
	arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
	slice_head(n = 15) |>
	select(player, career_home_runs, seasons_played, steroid_era_status)

ggplot(career_home_runs, aes(x = career_home_runs, y = player)) +
	geom_col(aes(fill = steroid_era_status)) +
	scale_fill_manual(
		values = c(
			"Active during steroid era" = "#d94841",
			"Not active during steroid era" = "#6b7280"
		)
	) +
	labs(
		title = "Career Home Run Leaders by Steroid-Era Activity",
		x = "Career home runs",
		y = "Player",
		fill = "Steroid-era activity",
		caption = "Source: Lahman database"
	)

bonds_home_runs <- Batting |>
	filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
	group_by(yearID) |>
	summarise(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(bonds_home_runs, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
	geom_col(fill = "#d94841") +
	labs(
		title = "Barry Bonds: Home Runs by Season",
		x = "Season",
		y = "Home runs",
		caption = "Source: Lahman database"
	)
```
